title: Threshold repetition for entangled games

result.label: Threshold repetition for entangled games
result.statement: Proves exponential threshold repetition for every finite two-player one-round game: if its entangled value is v k independent repetitions decays exponentially in k , for 0 1-v. Arbitrary joint finite-dimensional entangled strategies and correlated question distributions are allowed.
